name: Temporal Gaussian Splatting
definition: A training-free, plug-and-play algorithmic approach to accelerate 3DGS rendering by leveraging temporal priors (geometry and appearance buffers) from previous frames to reduce redundancy in Gaussian preprocessing, sorting, and rasterization.
summary: Temporal Gaussian Splatting is a training-free acceleration method for 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses temporal priors to reduce computational redundancy and achieve up to 1.48x speedup.
